messages:
Marta: quick check-in 1h sprint: we need compact hero variants for the launch landing (hosted / dedicated / private), a short webinar hook, and routing decisions for inbound leads. keep it lean.
Liam: I'll outline technical microcopy for hosted + dedicated. prefer hero angle that speaks to "predictable performance" not hype.
Nina: drafting three 1-line heroes now. thinking short + functional: 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency', 'Reserved capacity, guaranteed throughput', 'Private deployments with enterprise controls'.
Noah: want visual guidance too  single-column hero, small supporting blurb, right-side CTA. Can we keep CTA copy under 4 words?
Sylvia: for social we should plan 3 posts: launch announcement, benchmark snapshot (latency win), and webinar reminder. each post -> CTA to landing. cadence: announcement Day 0, benchmark Day 2, reminder Day 5.
Ashok: I'll deliver two benchmark cards: p50/p99 and $/1k tokens. can show hosted vs major managed endpoint vs dedicated. Need to know which models to show.
Priya: for Private page add a short migration note: 'On-prem & VPC options. Onboarding checklist available in webinar.' that will help AE follow-up.
Marta: inbound routing: prefer single form with mode selector so we don't split SEO. use routing rules after form submit.
Liam: routing pseudocode for eng:
```
// landing form submission payload
mode = payload.mode // hosted | dedicated | private
if mode == 'hosted' -> tag: prospect:hosted, route: sd-portal
if mode == 'dedicated' -> tag: prospect:dedicated, route: ae-dedicated
if mode == 'private' -> tag: prospect:enterprise, route: ae-enterprise + legal_ops
```
Nina: CTA micro-variants: 'See benchmarks', 'Get started', 'Request demo'. I'll wire them to different traffic for A/B.
Noah: design note: use small lock icon for Private trust line: 'SOC2-ready, KMS-friendly' under the hero.
copy-bot: generated hero options:
- H1: "Predictable inference for production apps." sub: "One API. Hosted, reserved, or private deployments." CTA: "See benchmarks"
- H2: "Dedicated throughput, hosted ease." sub: "Choose the deployment that fits your SLA and budget." CTA: "Compare plans"
- H3: "Private deployment with enterprise controls." sub: "VPC, on-prem, audit logs, and KMS integrations." CTA: "Request demo"
Marta: good. Nina please convert H1 into 2 x 20-40 word lead paragraphs (hosted + dedicated focus) for landing. Priya to add short migration checklist bullet points for webinar slide.
Priya: will do. slide bullets: '1) size your traffic 2) pick mode 3) test with sample prompts 4) migrate KV cache'
Ashok: deadline check: benchmark assets by Tue noon, copy drafts by Tue 5pm, design comps Wed.
Sylvia: promo owners: me + Noah for creative, Nina for copy, Marta for approvals. I'll schedule social copy drops in content calendar.
Nina: uploading hosted/dedicated lead paragraphs to staging now. will include CTAs for A/B.
Marta: perfect. final ask: drop the final hero variant + primary CTA in this thread by Tue 5pm PST. sync Thursday to review performance hypotheses. :rocket:
